summary: Audit of EFSW OPERATE surfaces (/admin, /admin/login, /member/register, /member/login, /member/profile) covering forms, tables, states, accessibility, and density. 18 items: 3 high, 9 medium, 6 low.

items.issue: No field-level error state on inputs; failed login shows only a banner error and leaves both fields unmarked. Label wraps input so htmlFor is impossible and click-target association is implicit.
items.fix: Add aria-invalid to inputs on error, clear error on field change, and switch to explicit label htmlFor + id pairs. Add a short hint under password: 'Demo password available from the EFSW team.'
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: errors name the problem + the recovery; every control has error state

items.issue: Step-1 validation errors are generic ('Please complete all required fields') and do not identify which field failed. No field-level error styling on inputs; the banner is the only feedback. Password hint text missing (min 8 chars is only enforced silently).
items.fix: Add per-field error messages with aria-describedby, mark failing inputs with aria-invalid and .efsw-form-field--error, and add hint text under Password: 'At least 8 characters.'
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: errors name the problem + the recovery; labels above inputs with hint text

items.issue: Loading state is plain text 'Loading profile...' on an empty page. No skeleton or spinner; unauthenticated users see a flash of unstyled content before redirect.
items.fix: Replace with a branded loading state: centered spinner + 'Loading your profile...' in .efsw-auth-page wrapper, matching the admin loading pattern.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: every control has loading state; no unstyled flash

items.issue: Table header is not sticky; on scroll the column labels disappear. Pagination only appears when >8 items; no total-count summary when filters yield few results. Row click target is the whole <tr> but keyboard focus is not managed (tr lacks tabindex/role).
items.fix: Make thead sticky with top-0 bg-surface-base z-10. Always show 'N members' result count. Add tabindex='0' and role='button' to rows, with Enter/Space key handler, or convert row click to a proper button in the first cell.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: density optimized for scanning; keyboard focus visible

items.issue: Empty state is a generic 'No members match your filters' with AlertCircle. No guidance on how to clear filters or add a member. No search-clear button.
items.fix: Add a clear-filters action in the empty state: 'Clear search and filters' button. If truly empty (no members at all), show first-run orientation: 'No members yet. Approve pending applications or export a CSV template.'
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: empty states offer first-run orientation

items.issue: Filter tabs show counts but the grid empty state is a bare 'No content matches your filters.' Card grid has no skeleton loading state; on slow devices the area collapses to zero height during fetch.
items.fix: Add a 3-card skeleton pulse while content is loading. Empty state should include 'Create your first content item' button when filters are default.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: loading skeleton vs spinner; empty state orientation

items.issue: Toggle switch has no visible focus ring (relies on outline but has border-2 border-transparent which clips it). Success feedback is temporary text; no aria-live announcement. Form lacks a dirty-state indicator before saving.
items.fix: Add focus-visible ring to toggle. Wrap success message in aria-live='polite'. Show 'Unsaved changes' dot when formData differs from props.settings.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: focus ring visible; success state announced

items.issue: Sub-tabs are plain buttons without aria-current or tab styling semantics. Save success message appears inline but disappears after 2.5s with no aria-live. Section visibility toggles are raw checkboxes without switch styling.
items.fix: Add role='tablist' + aria-selected to tab buttons. Add aria-live='polite' to save feedback. Style section toggles as switches consistent with AdminSettingsView.

items.issue: No empty state illustration or guidance when activity log is empty. Filter pills lack counts. No export or date-range filter for audit compliance.
items.fix: Add empty state: 'No activity recorded yet. Actions will appear here as you work.' Add counts to filter pills. Add 'Export log' button for compliance.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: empty states; audit trail utility

items.issue: Image upload shows 'Processing and compressing image...' text but no progress bar or spinner. No error state shown to user if compression fails (only console.error). No image dimension/size hint before upload.
items.fix: Add a small spinner or progress bar during compression. Show inline error if compression fails: 'Image could not be processed. Try a smaller file.' Add hint: 'Recommended: 1200×630px, under 2MB.'
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: loading and error states; hint text

items.issue: Save note button shows 'Saving...' for a fixed 1s then stops, regardless of actual save completion. No error state if note save fails. Drawer lacks focus trap; tabbing escapes to background.
items.fix: Disable button while isSavingNote and show checkmark on success. Add aria-live for save confirmation. Add focus trap and return focus to the triggering row on close.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: real loading state; focus management

items.issue: Edit form has no cancel button; user must switch tabs to discard changes. No dirty-state warning when leaving the edit tab. Success message auto-dismisses after 2s with no aria-live.
items.fix: Add 'Cancel' button next to 'Save Changes' that resets draft. Warn on tab switch if draft is dirty. Add aria-live='polite' to status messages.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: form recovery paths; state announcements

items.issue: Step indicator is text-only ('01 Account', '02 Professional') with no progress bar or aria-current. Radio cards for membership type are labels wrapping inputs, but the selected state is CSS-only (.is-selected) with no aria-checked reinforcement.
items.fix: Add role='tablist' or a progress bar to steps. Add aria-current='step' to active step. Ensure radio inputs have aria-checked via native radio behavior and add visible focus ring to the card labels.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/craft-floor: focus ring visible; native expectations

items.issue: Demo hint exposes the demo email in plaintext <code> but says 'Contact admin for password' — inconsistent security posture. No dark-mode variant for the admin auth page (uses light admin palette while site is dark-first).
items.fix: Remove demo email from UI or gate behind an environment flag. Align admin auth background with the dark petrol brand surface or add a theme toggle.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: brand lives in precise details; security posture consistency

items.issue: Sidebar nav buttons use color alone for active state (bg-teal text-white). No aria-current='page' on active view. Mobile backdrop has aria-hidden but no role or aria-label.
items.fix: Add aria-current='page' to active nav button. Add role='presentation' and aria-label='Close navigation' to backdrop.

items.issue: 'Live Sync' badge pulses with animate-pulse but conveys no real sync status. Date format is hardcoded to th-TH regardless of admin locale preference.
items.fix: Remove animate-pulse or replace with a real last-synced timestamp. Use the admin's selected locale from settings for date formatting.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: copy is concrete claim; density

items.issue: Quick action links are anchor tags with href='#card' etc. that do not navigate; they scroll nowhere and break native expectations. Avatar in sidebar is a plain div with first initial, no image support.
items.fix: Replace dead anchor links with buttons that switch tabs or link to real sections. Add AvatarUpload component to sidebar for profile photo.

items.issue: Table rows have py-3.5 px-4 with font-size text-xs (0.75rem) but line-height is default; multi-line cells (name+email) feel cramped. No tabular-nums on dates or counts, causing column jitter when filtering.
items.fix: Add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to date and count cells. Increase row padding to py-4 and set line-height 1.4 on cell text for better scanability.
items.skill_rule: impeccable/operate: density optimized for scanning; numbers tabular
